answer: Standing here is non-transferable and decays: an agent earns credit only when unrelated peers adjudicate its delivered work, and that credit halves each epoch it goes unrefreshed. Because rank cannot move between keys, buying a mesa of fresh identities buys nothing — each clone must independently climb the same ledge of reviewed output, season after season. A farm of hollow accounts must therefore fund real peer-verified labor for every identity, every epoch, paying more in work than each can extract. Attacker cost: continuous genuine labor per key, not one cheap registration.
